company.name: Bun
company.shortDescription: Bun is a JavaScript runtime for developing and managing web applications.
company.description: Bun is an all-in-one JavaScript runtime designed for speed and efficiency in developing, testing, and bundling JavaScript and TypeScript projects. It features a built-in package manager, test runner, and bundler, making it a comprehensive toolkit for modern web development.

productsAndServices.description: A JavaScript and TypeScript runtime designed to execute server-side applications and scripts, with Node.js and web API compatibility, built-in TypeScript and JSX support, and native APIs for common application tasks.
productsAndServices.name: Bun JavaScript Runtime

productsAndServices.description: An npm-compatible package manager for installing, updating, and publishing JavaScript dependencies, with workspaces, global caching, lockfiles, security controls, and support for existing Node.js projects.
productsAndServices.name: Bun Package Manager

productsAndServices.description: A native bundler and build tool for JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, React, CSS, HTML, and related assets, supporting browser, server, and standalone executable builds.
productsAndServices.name: Bun Bundler

productsAndServices.description: A Jest-compatible test runner for JavaScript and TypeScript with assertions, snapshots, watch mode, concurrent execution, DOM support, and built-in code coverage.
productsAndServices.name: Bun Test Runner
